rollback_steps.requirement: Freeze unrelated application and editorial releases and record the first breached threshold using aggregate redacted evidence.
Keep the complete 1590-alias one-hop redirect inventory active; never replace an alias with a home-page redirect or a redirect chain.
Restore the last accepted immutable application image while retaining compatible Django dynamic endpoints and forward-only data.
Re-run all 796 final and 1590 alias probes plus robots, sitemap, canonical, Open Graph, and JSON-LD checks before declaring rollback stable.
Verify the breached 15-minute or 60-minute HTTP window twice and the next complete UTC day for delayed Search Console and organic recovery.
The SEO cutover commander records the decision; the website on-call engineer executes; the product manager accepts recovery before release work resumes.

human_gate.evidence: aggregate and redacted; no account, token, registration, raw IP, or production record data
